consumer: The crafting menu's recipe-eligibility logic (recipe::can_make / availability over the player's crafting_inventory), asking 'can this selected recipe be crafted right now?'
scope: The full crafting inventory within crafting range — components, tools, qualities, and charges reachable from nearby map tiles and vehicles, not just on-person items
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — it enumerates raw wielded/worn/inventory items into JSON, doing no recipe-eligibility computation and no nearby-reachable-inventory inclusion
divergence: A recipe whose required tool or component sits on an adjacent tile or in a nearby vehicle: the engine reports it craftable, but carried_items omits those items so the surface answers 'not present' / cannot judge eligibility
